title: Best LMS *by use case*
verdict.sub: There is no single best LMS. Start from how you teach.

rows.why: Test-series focus; Launcher ₹10,000/yr + 10%, or 0% fee on monthly plans

rows.need: You run a training business with batches and branches
rows.why: Built for training businesses; from ₹7,499/month billed annually

rows.need: You sell above ₹2.3 lakh a year and want a flat price
rows.why: Lists ₹29,999 a year; ask about GST and any fee on sales

rows.need: You already run a WordPress site
rows.why: USD plugins; hosting, gateway and upkeep are yours
